name: Remote MCP Server on Cloudflare
description: Enables deployment of MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers with OAuth authentication and remote connectivity. Provides a template for creating cloud-hosted MCP servers that can be accessed by Claude Desktop and other MCP clients over HTTP/SSE.
